basic_profile.bio: A 34-year-old aspiring jazz musician from Portland, Oregon, currently working as a freelance graphic designer. After resolving a long-standing breathing issue, they've rediscovered their passion for playing the flute, an instrument they haven't touched in a decade. Enjoys exploring new music genres, especially folk metal and jazz. Typically online during late evenings when work slows down. Single and enjoys hiking and local music festivals during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: This user has a Bachelor’s degree in Fine Arts with a minor in Music Theory. They originally learned to play the flute during high school and were part of a local band. They have a foundational understanding of music, which they are eager to expand into jazz. Often self-teaches through online resources and community recommendations.
